# dataset.constructors.fmri_dataset { #fmrimod.dataset.constructors.fmri_dataset }

```python
fmri_dataset(
    img=None,
    *,
    mask=None,
    tr=None,
    events=None,
    censor=None,
    start_time=None,
    slice_timing_offset=None,
    run_length=None,
    confounds=None,
    data_source=None,
    event_table=None,
)
```

Construct the canonical `FmriDataset` from an image source.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                | Type                                                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Default   |
|---------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| img                 | object                                                     | Image source. See module docstring for accepted types.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `None`    |
| mask                | object                                                     | Optional mask. Accepts a NeuroVol/LogicalNeuroVol, 3-D boolean ndarray, nibabel image, or path to a NIfTI volume. Defaults to non-zero voxels of the first volume.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `None`    |
| tr                  | float \| Sequence\[float\] \| None                         | Repetition time in seconds. Required for image inputs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `None`    |
| events              | pd.DataFrame \| Sequence\[pd.DataFrame\] \| None           | Optional event table: one DataFrame with a ``run`` column (1-based) for multi-run data, or a sequence of per-run DataFrames (BIDS ``*_events.tsv`` style, onsets relative to each run's start), which is stacked into one table with ``run`` filled in.                                                                                                                                                                                          | `None`    |
| censor              | NDArray\[np.bool_\] \| list\[NDArray\[np.bool_\]\] \| None | Optional boolean censor vector(s).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `None`    |
| start_time          | float \| Sequence\[float\] \| None                         | Slice-timing offset in seconds; the realised sampling grid is ``start_time + k * TR`` for ``k`` in ``0..n_scans-1``. Default is ``TR/2`` (BOLD-midpoint convention — the value at sample ``k`` represents the BOLD signal at the middle of the ``k``-th TR window). Pass ``slice_timing_offset=0.0`` for frame-start sampling (Nilearn / SPM-MAT / FitLins convention). The two names are interchangeable; if both are supplied they must agree. | `None`    |
| slice_timing_offset | float \| Sequence\[float\] \| None                         | Slice-timing offset in seconds; the realised sampling grid is ``start_time + k * TR`` for ``k`` in ``0..n_scans-1``. Default is ``TR/2`` (BOLD-midpoint convention — the value at sample ``k`` represents the BOLD signal at the middle of the ``k``-th TR window). Pass ``slice_timing_offset=0.0`` for frame-start sampling (Nilearn / SPM-MAT / FitLins convention). The two names are interchangeable; if both are supplied they must agree. | `None`    |
| run_length          | int \| Sequence\[int\] \| None                             | Split a single 2-D ``(time, voxels)`` matrix into multiple runs. Mirrors `matrix_dataset`'s ``run_length``. Only valid for 2-D ndarray input; raises ``ValueError`` for any other ``img`` type, including sequences (which already encode runs explicitly) and 4-D ndarrays.                                                                                                                                                               | `None`    |
| confounds           | pd.DataFrame \| Sequence\[pd.DataFrame\] \| None           | Optional nuisance tables, one per run (or one table covering all runs back to back). They are stored on the dataset; a spec term ``confounds("trans_x", ...)`` without ``source=`` picks its columns from them at fit time.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `None`    |
| data_source         | DatasetProtocol \| None                                    | Legacy alias accepting a `DatasetProtocol`-compatible object.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `None`    |
| event_table         | pd.DataFrame \| None                                       | Legacy alias for ``events``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `None`    |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

Two runs from NIfTI files with per-run BIDS event tables::

    ds = fmri_dataset(
        ["run-1_bold.nii.gz", "run-2_bold.nii.gz"],
        mask="brain_mask.nii.gz",
        tr=2.0,
        events=[events_run1, events_run2],
    )

A ``(time, voxels)`` matrix split into two runs:

```python
>>> import numpy as np, pandas as pd
>>> events = pd.DataFrame({"onset": [4.0, 4.0], "duration": 1.0,
...                        "trial_type": ["a", "b"], "run": [1, 2]})
>>> ds = fmri_dataset(np.zeros((40, 3)), tr=2.0, run_length=[20, 20],
...                   events=events)
>>> ds.n_runs
2
```
